pages.title: Buried Lunch
pages.text: Plant barley, oats, a tomato or lettuce crop.

pages.title: Buried Lunch
pages.text: One planting starts a useful little garden.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Hoe soil near water, then plant seeds. The reward adds new crops to your patch.

pages.title: Raise kitchen crops
pages.text: Wild barley, oats, corn, tomatoes, lettuce, onions and strawberries provide different kitchen ingredients. Grow what your recipes need instead of collecting every crop name.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Crafting, building, farming, combat, trading and dimensions remain the survival backbone. Backports add some newer minecraft-namespaced items; installed owners and pack rules determine their availability.
